decisions.statement: An address is the page type and the slug the change is filed under.
The page at an address is read off the index rather than found by a search.
A change's code is beside its page under the key its page type declares.
Every change exports its run under one name.
An agent change states the arguments that change takes beside its run, under one name.
A key no change reached by name takes is refused before that change runs.
One key is refused at a time.
The arguments a change takes are said to a caller from the change's own list.
A change stating no arguments is said to take none.
A help answer opens with the call and the change's own definition.
A change stating no definition is answered with the call alone.
Both spellings of the help flag are told apart from an argument here.
The space at either end of what is piped in is not read as part of the flag.
A change reached by another change has no key judged here.
A change stating no arguments has no key judged here.
An address reaching no page is refused rather than answered with no edits.
An address naming no page and a body exporting no run are two refusals.
Loading a change and running that change are two acts.
Loading a change reaches the disk.
A change is loaded from the path its code sits at rather than the path named.
A change reached more than once over one world is looked up once.
A world reached over twice looks a change up again for the second world.
A lock a caller has over a store is held while a change reached inside loads.
The target subtype a change acts on is read off that change's page.
The subtype a change judges a path against is worked out once over one world.
The path handed in is read under the name every change names a path by.
A path whose kind narrows the subtype the change acts on is run.
Every other path is refused before the change is run.
A change acting on no file subtype has no path judged here.
A change acting on a file of any kind has no path judged.
A call handing in no path has no path judged here.
No change is imported here.
Nothing here has an address to the arguments that address takes.
A change whose code throws while loading refuses the run rather than the landing.
Every answer a change gives is dropped from.
An answer a change reached inside gives is dropped from at that rung too.

definition: the change filed at an address, loaded and run for the answer it gives
